verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੁ ਜੋ ਭਗਤਾ ਓਹਰੀ ਜਾਪੂਵੰਸੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: bhagat jo bhagataa oharee jaapoova(n)see sev kamaavai|

en.bdb: A devotee named Bhagata of Ohari caste and Bhagat of Japuvansi family were two sikhs that served the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੀਹਾਂ ਉਪਲੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਗਜਣੁ ਉਪਲੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: seehaa(n) upal jaaneeaai gajan upal satigur bhaavai|

en.bdb: Sihan, the Uppal, and Gajjan of Uppal caste were very dear to the true Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੈਲਸੀਹਾਂ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਭਾਗੀਰਥੁ ਕਾਲੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: mailaseehaa(n) vich aakheeaai bhaageerath kaalee gun gaavai|

en.bdb: One Bhagirath of  Malsihan town was there who earlier was a devotee of Kali,  the goddess.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤਾ ਰੰਧਾਵਾ ਭਲਾ ਹੈ ਬੂੜਾ ਬੁਢਾ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: jitaa ra(n)dhaavaa bhalaa hai booRaa buddaa ik man dhiaavai|

en.bdb: Jita of Randhava was also a fine Sikh and Bhai Budda, whose earlier name was Bura, would remember the Lord with single devotion.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਣਾ ਖਹਿਰਾ ਜੋਧੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਜੀਵਾਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵ ਸਮਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: firanaa khahiraa jodh sikh jeevaiee gur sev samaavai|

en.bdb: Bhai Phirana  of Khaira caste, Jodh and Jiva always remained absorbed in the service of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਜਰੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਲੁਹਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੀ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: gujar jaat luhaar hai gur sikhee gursikh sunaavai|

en.bdb: One Lohar caste Sikh named Gujjar was there who preached Sikhism to the Sikhs of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਈ ਧਿੰਙੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਤਰਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: naiee dhi(n)n(g) vakhaaneeaai satigur sev kuTa(n)b taraavai|

en.bdb: Dhinga, the barber, serving the Guru got his whole family liberated.
The gurmukhs having sight of the Lord themselves, make others also to have the same glimpse.
